Container.Name: medialab-server
Container.Overview: medialab Server: a GPL-2.0 fork of Jellyfin with the medialab plugin catalog, signed-plugin verification and Live TV fixes. Installed from the signed medialab apt packages. Settings, plugins and the first administrator can be set from the variables below (see the README for the full list).
Container.Requires: Intel/AMD GPU: add "--device=/dev/dri" to Extra Parameters and set MLW_HW_ACCEL to qsv or vaapi. For NVIDIA, install the Nvidia-Driver plugin, add "--runtime=nvidia" and set MLW_HW_ACCEL to nvenc.

Config.Name: Discovery
Config.Description: Client auto-discovery on the local network

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id of the server (Unraid: 99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id of the server (Unraid: 100 = users)

Config.Name: NVIDIA devices
Config.Description: NVIDIA only: GPU UUID or all

Config.Name: Published URL
Config.Description: Public address given to clients, e.g. https://media.example.org

Config.Name: Admin user
Config.Description: Creates this administrator and skips the setup wizard (new servers only)

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Used once with Admin user; you can clear it after the first start

Config.Name: Plugins
Config.Description: medialab plugins to install, e.g. jf-rosub,jf-registration@1.0.2

Config.Name: Repository key
Config.Description: Your medialab.works repository key (jfr_...), for licensed plugin versions

Config.Name: Licence key
Config.Description: Passed to the plugins that support reading it from the environment

Config.Name: Config mode
Config.Description: first-run: write settings on new servers and when a value changes; enforce: at every start
